messages:
owen: Orion Tech opened a billing dispute \u2014 they were issued a goodwill credit twice for Q2 onboarding promo. They want the duplicate credit reversed. Screenshot attached.
yasmin: Invoice INV-2026-0707-210 shows PROMO-CREDIT -$4,000.00 and PROMO-CREDIT -$4,000.00 (duplicate). They request reversal of one credit ($4,000).
orion-tech-support: Confirmed on our portal only one promo code was applied. Looks like billing run reprocessed the promo during a partial retry window.
maria: Because requested reversal is >=$4k but <=$5k, manager approval is required; legal not needed per FIN-REF-3. Need ENG ticket for billing reprocess and account owner sign-off.
trey: Filing ENG-TASK-2026-1843 to look into promo reapply during retry window, assigned eng-billing.
eng-billing: Investigating. Early hypothesis: promo-sync job retried and billing-run dedupe skipped for promo entries.
yasmin: Account owner DM'ed approval to reverse the duplicate credit and prefers we apply a debit memo rather than immediate chargeback.
maria: Approve debit memo approach. Please add ledger note linking ENG-TASK-2026-1843 and include account owner confirmation for audit.
owen: Operational commands to run once approved:
```nbilling-tool debit-create --customer cust_OR71 --invoice INV-2026-0707-210 --amount 4000.00 --currency USD --reason "Reversal of duplicate onboarding promo credit" --gl-code REV-ADJ
# add ledger note: ENG-TASK-2026-1843, account owner consent pasted
```
finance-bot: Policy check passed. Debit memo dm_0f9c1 created and queued. Ledger note appended.
orion-tech-support: Thanks 44d. We'll confirm when offset appears on next invoice and will monitor for repeat issues.
eng-billing: Added retry safeguard to promo-sync; will deploy fix in next patch. Ticket ENG-TASK-2026-1843 remains open.
maria: Closing loop: Debit memo created for $4,000 to reverse duplicate credit; ENG-TASK-2026-1843 created for root cause. Finance to follow up if any settlement issues.
